resumen: Holding the body straight on forearms and toes. Nothing bends: the work is keeping the hips from sagging.
ejecucion: Put your forearms on the floor, elbows right under your shoulders.
Straighten your legs and rest on your toes, body in a straight line.
Squeeze glutes and abs and tuck the hips slightly: that is what keeps the back from sagging.
Hold while breathing normally, and stop when the hips start to drop.
matices: Drawing the abdomen in while holding —the hollowing maneuver— raises activation across the core, and especially in the obliques.
